c4_authority.global_case: Only the unanimously selected dynamic top family may be tested in a global surgical teacher-forced C4 counterfactual. All other closures/states remain unchanged.

interpretation_constraints: Rank-1 is based on cumulative mass-neutral shape injection, not raw flux RMS.
HOLD may corroborate or contradict mechanism interpretation but cannot rescue failed dynamic unanimity.

C4 tests causal removal/replacement of one bias channel under teacher forcing; it is not a free-trajectory production model.
